description: This file defines a Publisher entity for a book management system, with fields for ID, name, and a set of books. It includes JPA annotations for ORM mapping, Lombok annotations for boilerplate code reduction, and JSON annotations to control serialization. The class also implements custom equals and hashCode based on the 'name' field.

classes.name: Publisher
classes.description: Entity class representing a publisher with a unique name and a set of associated books. Configured with JPA and Lombok annotations, it manages persistence and boilerplate code, and overrides toString, equals, and hashCode for meaningful object representation and comparison.
